title: **Reconcile historical normalized keys before deploying the blank-query
blocker: fix.** Existing service rows with blank or bare identity parameters, including a blank value before a nonempty repeated value, may carry a different key than the Python index. A read-only audit on 2026-10-21 using the existing application pool and local environment was rejected with ER_ACCESS_DENIED_ERROR before any rows were read; no credentials were changed or printed. Blocked on a working supported read-only database connection. Then count affected rows and potential collisions, and design a recoverable re-key if needed. Do not infer stored-data parity from the 18 synthetic cases, rebuild an index, merge captures or mutate production rows automatically. Eight database integration cases remain unexecuted without a configured isolated database; production is not a test fixture.
